summary: CareTrust REIT filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a 17,000,000-share forward-settled common stock offering (19,550,000 if the greenshoe is exercised) through Bank of America and Morgan Stanley as forward purchasers. Pricing is left blank; the last NYSE sale price on November 10, 2026 was $38.84. No proceeds are received at launch, with physical settlement anticipated within one year; cash or net share settlement remain alternatives. A 9.8% ownership charter limit applies. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch forward settlement dilution and pricing.
